channel.title: CLI :: Gonemaster
channel.description: This page documents gonemaster, the direct local test runner. It runs the engine in the current process without gonemaster-server. gonemaster normalizes IDN domains to IDNA A-labels before use. An IPv4 or IPv6 address is tested as its reverse name under in-addr.arpa (RFC 1035 section 3.5) or ip6.arpa (RFC 3596 section 2.5). This page is for the local runner only. The server client is documented under client/ , including job and batch operations.
